intro: Bring your domains in through Cloudflare or pull an existing mailbox, then pick how replies go out. Each reply leaves from the address the message was sent to.
oauthNote: Opens {{provider}} in your browser to sign in. Buun Mail never sees your password.
notWired: Connecting arrives with the sync step. Nothing typed here is saved or sent.

file.note: Messages are filed into workspaces by the address they were delivered to, read from Delivered-To, then X-Original-To, then To. A message imported twice is kept once.
file.desktopOnly: Importing works in the desktop app.
file.reportFailed: {{added}} added, {{duplicates}} already here, {{failed}} could not be read.

cloudflare.name: Cloudflare Email Routing
cloudflare.summary: Your own domains through one catch-all Worker. Every message keeps its exact recipient.

gmail.name: Gmail
gmail.summary: Read over IMAP and send over SMTP with a Google app password.

outlook.name: Outlook
outlook.summary: Needs sign-in with Microsoft, which requires an app registration in Azure; not set up yet.

proton.name: Proton Mail
proton.summary: Read and send through Proton Mail Bridge running on this computer.

icloud.name: iCloud Mail
icloud.summary: Read over IMAP and send over SMTP with an app-specific password.

zoho.name: Zoho Mail
zoho.summary: Read over IMAP and send over SMTP with an app password.

imap.name: Other IMAP
imap.summary: Any IMAP mailbox: new mail every two minutes, never marked read there.

file.name: Import a file
file.summary: Messages exported from another client, as .eml or .mbox.

resend.name: Resend
resend.summary: Send as any address on a domain verified in Resend.

ses.name: Amazon SES
ses.summary: Send through SES in the region your domains are verified in.

mailgun.name: Mailgun
mailgun.summary: Send through a Mailgun domain, US or EU.

smtp.name: SMTP
smtp.summary: Any server that relays mail over TLS.

gateway.name: Buun Mail Gateway
gateway.summary: Your domains through the Buun Group mail gateway. Mail waits there until this app collects it, with its exact recipient.

fields.cloudflareAccountHint: Cloudflare dashboard, any zone, right-hand column.
fields.cloudflareTokenHint: Needs Email Routing Rules: Edit and Workers Scripts: Edit.
fields.bridgePasswordHint: The one Bridge shows, not your Proton password.
fields.applePasswordHint: Make one at account.apple.com, Sign-In and Security.
fields.sesSecretHint: An IAM user with ses:SendRawEmail only.

gateway.tokenHint: Starts with bmg_. Shown once when the mailbox was made.
gateway.received_one: {{count}} message collected since the app started
gateway.received_other: {{count}} messages collected since the app started
gateway.desktopOnly: Connecting works in the desktop app.
gateway.none: No gateway yet. Each Cloudflare account can run its own gateway; add each one here.
gateway.confirmRemove: Stop collecting from {{name}}? Mail already here stays.

domains.title: Domains
domains.intro: Mail to these domains comes to this gateway. Only domains in the gateway's Cloudflare account can be added.
domains.none: No domains yet. Add one below.
domains.confirmRemove: Remove {{domain}}? Its mail goes back to: {{rule}}.
domains.confirmRemoveOff: Remove {{domain}}? Its catch-all is switched off again.
domains.noneAvailable: Every domain in the gateway's Cloudflare account is already connected.
domains.warning: All mail to @{{domain}} that no other Cloudflare rule names will come here instead of: {{rule}}. Removing the domain puts that back.
domains.addRelayed: A domain in another Cloudflare account
domains.relayedHint: Its mail reaches this gateway through a relay Worker in that account. Nothing changes in Cloudflare from here.

resend.hint: A full-access key brings its domains with it. Any address on a verified domain can send, so replies go out from the address the mail was sent to.
resend.noDomains: No domains on this account yet. Add one at Resend, then refresh.
resend.signaturePlaceholder: Added under new messages and replies sent through this key
resend.domainsLabel: Domains this key may send from
resend.domainsHint: This key may only send, so Resend will not list its domains. Separate them with commas.

hints.gmail: Use an app password from your Google account (Security, App passwords), with two-step verification on.
hints.icloud: Use an app-specific password from your Apple account.
hints.fastmail: Use an app password from Fastmail's settings.
hints.zoho: Use an app password if two-factor sign-in is on.
hints.proton: Proton Mail Bridge must be running on this computer; use the password it shows.
hints.custom: Your provider's SMTP server, port and security.

smtp.none: None (only for a server on this computer)
smtp.domainsHint: Usually your address's domain; separate several with commas.

hints.gmail: Turn on two-step verification, then make an app password in your Google account (Security, App passwords). Mail stays on Gmail too.
hints.icloud: Make an app-specific password in your Apple account.
hints.fastmail: Make an app password in Fastmail's settings, with IMAP access.
hints.zoho: Turn on IMAP access in Zoho Mail's settings; use an app password if two-factor sign-in is on.
hints.proton: Proton Mail Bridge must be running on this computer, set to plain connections; use the password Bridge shows.
hints.custom: Your provider's IMAP server, usually port 993 with TLS.

imap.firstTake: Its newest 200 messages are coming in; new mail follows every two minutes.
imap.checkFailed: The mailboxes could not be checked
